sources.note: Fu Jen Catholic University, Office of Academic Affairs - 'Scholarships > Fu Jen Catholic University' page. This is the awarding body's own site (idsaoie.fju.edu.tw, footer: 'Fu Jen Catholic University / Office of Academic Affairs / Cardinal Tien Memorial Building A117, No. 510, Zhongzheng Rd., Xinzhuang Dist., New Taipei City 242062'). Lists the doctoral award terms.

Same official site, 'Apply > Key Dates' page (bilingual EN/ZH). Publishes the Spring 2027 and Fall 2027 application windows for degree-seeking international students. The scholarship page itself carries no deadline, so the deadline was read here.

Same official site, 'Regulations > Scholarship' page. Confirms a dedicated doctoral scholarship regulation exists (輔仁大學外國籍博士新生獎學金實施辦法). The PDF is Chinese-only and binary; I could not extract its text.

awarding_body.detail: The page is Fu Jen Catholic University's own Office of Academic Affairs (Admissions) site, not an aggregator or news article. The award is listed under 'Fu Jen Scholarships', i.e. the university's own institutional scholarship for foreign nationals.
awarding_body.quote: Fu Jen Catholic University / Office of Academic Affairs / Cardinal Tien Memorial Building A117, No. 510, Zhongzheng Rd., Xinzhuang Dist., New Taipei City 242062

deadline.detail: The scholarship page states no deadline of its own; the Key Dates page on the same official site publishes the exact windows quoted in the record. Spring 2027 online application runs 14 September 2026 13:00 to 14 October 2026 23:59 - that window is open as of today (12 October 2026) and closes in two days. Fall 2027 follows in two rounds, the first also opening 15 October 2026. Both windows in the record's deadline_label match the page word for word.
deadline.quote: 2027 春季班外國學生申請入學招生 / Admission for Degree-Seeking International Students Spring 2027 / 線上申請與繳件 Apply online and submit required documents / 2026年9月14日13:00至10月14日23:59 September 14 (13:00) to October 14 (23:59), 2026 — and: 第一梯次 The first round / 2026年10月15日13:00至12月4日23:59 October 15 (13:00) to December 4 (23:59), 2026

eligibility.detail: Confirmed that the award is for new international students who apply for it through the online admission system and that admission is a precondition - the page says the scholarship 'begins in the semester for which the recipient was granted admission and after the recipient has completed registration', and that applications are made together with the admission application. The record's 'tick the scholarship when submitting the online admission application' is a fair reading of 'Please apply for the scholarship when applying for admission on the online system'; the page does not literally describe a checkbox.
eligibility.quote: Please apply for the scholarship when applying for admission on the online system. For the latest information, please refer to the admission brochure for that semester.

funding.detail: Confirmed as tuition/miscellaneous fee waiver or reduction plus a stipend, for eight consecutive semesters. The record's funding_type 'Tuition Fee Waiver, Stipend' matches. Note the page says fees are 'waived or reduced', so the waiver is not guaranteed to be total; the award covers no accommodation, airfare or other living support. It is not a 'fully funded' package in the broad sense, but the record does not claim one.
funding.quote: The scholarship is awarded for eight consecutive semesters. The scholarship begins in the semester for which the recipient was granted admission and after the recipient has completed registration. Tuition and miscellaneous fees are waived or reduced as part of the scholarship and the recipient receives a stipend of NT$50,000 per semester. The stipend is disbursed in monthly installments of NT$10,000 after the recipient completes registration for the semester.

degree_levels.detail: The doctoral section of the page covers doctoral degree programmes, matching the record's 'PhD'. Undergraduate and master's students are covered by separate, differently-funded awards on the same page (four semesters at NT$10,000/30,000/50,000 per semester for those enrolled AY 114 and before; semester-of-admission NT$10,000 for AY 115), so this record is correctly scoped to the doctoral programme only.
degree_levels.quote: New International Students in Doctoral Degree Programs

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Apply online and submit required documents - Spring 2027: September 14 (13:00) to October 14 (23:59), 2026. Fall 2027 first round: October 15 (13:00) to December 4 (23:59), 2026; second round: March 1 (13:00) to May 15 (23:59), 2027.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Deadlines are NOT on the scholarship page; they live on the Key Dates page (https://idsaoie.fju.edu.tw/administration.jsp?labelID=4), which renders bilingual EN/ZH. The scholarship page carries a disclaimer: 'The scholarship is subject to change. Please refer to the admission brochure of that semester as accurate.' Amounts and durations are stated for AY115+ entry (doctoral: 8 semesters, fees waived or reduced, NT$50,000 per semester in NT$10,000 monthly instalments); older AY114-and-before rules differ. The linked doctoral regulation PDF (輔仁大學外國籍博士新生獎學金實施辦法, http://idsa.oie.docs.fju.edu.tw/) is Chinese-only and could not be parsed. As of 12 Oct 2026 the Spring 2027 window closes in 2 days; from 15 Oct 2026 the Fall 2027 first round (to 4 Dec 2026) is the next open cycle.

notes_for_reviewer: The record is accurate as written, with two soft points: (1) the fee waiver is worded 'waived or reduced', so 'Tuition Fee Waiver' should be read as potentially partial; (2) the record's 'tick the scholarship when submitting the online admission application' paraphrases the page's 'Please apply for the scholarship when applying for admission on the online system' - substantively the same, but not a literal checkbox description. After 14 October 2026 the Spring 2027 cycle is closed and deadline_date/deadline_text should be rolled to the Fall 2027 first round (4 December 2026).
